earnings_quality_bridge.disagreement: Share-based compensation is not free: base cash OE does not subtract it twice, while the economic cost is carried through the fully diluted share denominator.

range.formula: (CFO - PP&E cash capex - intangible cash capex - lease principal/interest - interest income) / 0.86627

limitations: Both values are negative cash proxies, not a positive normalized earning-power estimate.
Maintenance and growth capex are not disclosed separately.
Investment purchases/sales and deposits are excluded; interest income is removed only in the strict core proxy.
SBC is not double-subtracted from CFO; dilution is captured in the per-share bridge.

capital_allocation.per_share_test: Use known fully diluted shares and core owner earnings; do not treat financing proceeds as operating success.

gates.reason: 证券、WVR、股本和主源已绑定；机器事实包仍需人工复核法定身份与股本规范化。
定点到现金的链条可解释；自动驾驶算法性能与安全尾部风险仍超出纯财务分析。
真实出货、ASP和许可增长成立，但产品毛利、应收、库存与亏损尚未证明经营杠杆。
量产工程和生态形成粘性，但下一代车型RFQ会重新开放竞争。
管理层推进量产，同时配售、可转债、奖励和关联结构显著改变每股经济。
2023–2025两套现金OE代理均为负；不能用非现金公允价值利润替代。
现金储备提供验证时间，但CARIAD现金支付与新CB不能从净现金叙事中遗漏；负现金OE使其不能被表述成通过。
正的可持续owner earnings分母尚不存在；只能做P/S校准与反向预期。
研究证据足以进入重点观察与条件晋级，但owner earnings与安全边际两道硬门禁未通过，当前不可形成价值投资决策。

source_gaps.gap: No customer-level design-win → contract → SOP → shipment → revenue → cash ledger.
No audited 2026H1 full financial statements or continuing-operations cash flow at cut-off.
No maintenance/growth R&D and capex split.
No completed pro-forma balance sheet after D-Robotics deconsolidation and July financing.
No named human approval; machine fact pack remains reconciliation_pending.

invalidation_tests.test: Two consecutive half-years of actual HSD/J6 shipment and SOP growth.
Product gross margin excluding pass-through controllers remains near or above 40%.
Receivables and inventory growth fall to no faster than revenue growth.
Adjusted operating loss absolute amount declines and core CFO approaches break-even.
Fully diluted per-share owner earnings becomes positive without fair-value or financing gains.
Non-related-party license revenue and next-generation platform renewals are independently evidenced.
